alignment_exception.reason: The centre band is a left-to-right argument: signals enter on the left, interpretation happens in the middle, decisions leave on the right. Centring the three lanes as a block preserves center-first at the page level; the lanes themselves must read laterally or the flow claim is lost. Every other zone is centred on the page axis.

zones.align: three lanes, centred as a block

feed_scale_floor: The hero, the secondary line, the decision labels and the payoff carry the takeaway and all read at 350px feed width. The six node questions are 17px and are supporting reference content, not the takeaway: they are legible at feed width but are the smallest load-bearing type on the page. Everything at or below 12px (rail tick labels, platform monograms, panel caveats) is deliberate micro annotation and is texture at feed scale.
footer_clearance: The closer line ends at y=1269 and the footer bar occupies 1272-1350. No animated element enters the outer 48px safe margin.
